reason: Automatic subscription authentication resolves the account from Skarbiec through Weles POST /reauth/resolve, then admits POST /reauth with subscription_id and account_revision. Deploy Weles 0.6 or newer before this gateway; the removed Weles account catalogue and mandatory brama:login tag are not migration requirements. A failed provider operation is recorded with its actual stage, response and browser state, not as a completed login. Account revision and Weles source revision are distinct. The runtime state remains readable by prior releases, but rolling back both services restores the old account-selection behavior.
